summary: The eight-load cap counts successful loads, allowing unbounded failed git/filesystem attempts and fleet-gate timeout multiplication.
Non-UTF8 git blobs and recursion-depth JSON can raise out of check 62 instead of degrading to an unsearched WARN.
Sanitization tokens inside quoted sample content skip the whole line and create a direct fabricated-row false-PASS.
Tracked backtick paths and missing-SHA fallbacks search mutable working-copy bytes rather than the committed artifact named by the body.
Escaped quotes, tilde fences, and nested details can silently yield no stems and PASS fabricated samples.
Stems after the first 40 are silently omitted, allowing a fabricated 41st row to receive an unqualified PASS.
Any unsearchable Sample-slot candidate downgrades all local misses to WARN; critic and human follow-through must remain binding.
Spot-check #952’s four WARN-only stems against the linked HF artifacts; they are absent from the committed local bank.
